cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you hold my shelf bracket for a moment? Level, please; the pencil line is a guide, not a suggestion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only a moment. I'm leaving for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Just turn the top screw until it takes the weight. Gently; don't bury the head.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. I've put the other screws in their holes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. A quarter-turn on those, then slide the shelf on to check the fit. Both hands, please. I'll fetch your coat.
